title: ABHBench: Evaluating Moral Decision-Making of Foundation Models from an Agentic Perspective
summary: ABHBench placed 12 foundation models in multimodal, first-person branching dilemmas based on Detroit: Become Human. Seventy-five percent shifted significantly between matched text-only and multimodal scenarios; this benchmark measures model responses to designed scenarios, not real-world moral conduct.
ai_technology: Foundation models evaluated in an agentic moral-decision benchmark
organization: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
